title: In these or those: näissä, noissa, niissä
focus: Recognise and produce the plural inessive demonstrative forms.

exercises.prompt: Context: Several storage compartments are open. The speaker indicates the farther-away compartments, visible to both people. exercises.explanation: Noissa is the inessive form of nuo and expresses a bounded inside or immediately located relation.

exercises.prompt: Context: Several storage compartments are open. The speaker indicates the nearby compartments. Choose the sentence that means “Bags are in these.” In an office. Start from nämä (“these”). Use the supplied subject laukut (“bags”).
exercises.explanation: Näissä is the inessive form of nämä and expresses a bounded inside or immediately located relation.

sentenceExplanation.pattern: subject being located + linking verb + inessive demonstrative location

parts.formation: the complete plural form is supplied

Correct. Näissä is the inessive form of nämä and expresses a bounded inside or immediately located relation.
“noissa” is the plural inessive form linked to nuo; use “näissä”, the plural inessive form linked to nämä.
“niissä” is the plural inessive form linked to ne; use “näissä”, the plural inessive form linked to nämä.
“nämä” is a plural nominative form for referents near the speaker; use “näissä”, the plural inessive form linked to nämä.
